headline: Bush order sought to expand the stem cell lines approved for federally funded research, using methods described as ethically responsible.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order aimed to increase the number of stem cell lines that federal research programs could use. It framed this expansion as limited to methods considered ethically responsible. No official summary was provided, so details on which methods qualified and how the approval process changed are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists who do stem cell research with federal funding
who_it_affects.how: The order likely changed which stem cell lines they could use in federally supported work.
These agencies were likely directed to carry out the expansion of approved stem cell lines.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 20, 2007; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
